data.one_liner: Vendor-agnostic API for accessing SQL-like databases
data.what_it_does: Provides a generic, vendor-agnostic API designed for accessing SQL-like databases. It is currently a work in progress intended to establish a simpler and better database design.
use_when: You want to contribute to the design of a new vendor-agnostic database API
You are experimenting with database abstractions
avoid_when: You need a stable, production-ready database solution
You require fully implemented database operations
strengths: Open to community discussion and pull requests
weaknesses: API is not finalized and lacks production readiness

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is a mature, production-ready SQLite database plugin for Flutter.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: It provides a robust, type-safe reactive persistence library for Dart and Flutter.
